name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
Set a 4px solid #004499 focus ring with 4.5:1 contrast on white for keyboard users.
This keeps the ring visible on all backgrounds while staying within WCAG 2.2 AA for large text.
Trade-off: the thicker ring uses more screen space, but it’s the safest choice for low-vision keyboard users.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring still risks blending into busy patterned backgrounds, especially on mobile where anti-aliasing blurs edges. A 2px ring with a 4px outer glow (4.5:1 contrast) would stay visible without bulk, but we need to test it on EXCAVA’s actual backgrounds to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:
Set a 4px solid #004499 focus ring with a 2px outer glow (4.5:1 contrast) on white backgrounds. This keeps the ring crisp on patterned backgrounds while adding a subtle glow to prevent blending, which mobile anti-aliasing often causes. Trade-off: the glow adds a slight visual softness, but it’s the only way to guarantee visibility across all EXCAVA’s surfaces without bulk.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring with a 2px outer glow still risks blending into patterned backgrounds when those patterns include blues near #004499—glows can mute or distort on busy textures. Test a 3px ring with a 1px solid white inner edge instead; it’s thinner but creates a crisp contrast boundary that anti-aliasing won’t soften. Settle it by testing both on EXCAVA’s actual backgrounds at 100% and 200% zoom with forced colors mode enabled.
